title: Locomotive drivetrain ownership and interface baseline
status: Preliminary integration baseline; no new fabrication geometry or accepted interface dimensions
owner_direction: This chat focuses only on locomotive drivetrain, including wheels, hydraulics and connections to frame and drive. Separate chats own passenger cars and locomotive/tender. Use the existing project site.

coordination.mechanism: Shared versioned Site source and this interface register. Read latest remote state before each edit; merge concurrent additions and never force-push.
coordination.rule: Scope assignments follow owner instruction. Proposed engineering interfaces remain pending until reconciled with each workstream. Do not treat publication as acceptance.

ownership.scope: Diesel-to-pump matching and coupling; hydraulic circuit, controls and cooling budget; traction motor; supported reduction/distributor; axle drive; powered wheels, axles, bearings, axleboxes and their suspension interfaces; torque reaction, mounts, guards and connection loads.

Overall Polar Express appearance, chassis arrangement and main frame, packaging, cab/body/tender, fuel/exhaust and installed equipment integration. Receives drivetrain envelope, hardpoints, loads, travel and cooling needs; coordinates engine/generator packaging.
Coach frame/body/interior and coach trucks/brakes. Supplies current loaded mass/CG, drawbar demand, brake trainline and electrical/HVAC demand. No coach geometry is revised here.

lead: Retain N2-D01: one H1B110 with mechanically distributed drive as lead comparison, not a final axle layout or order-ready selection.

interfaces.required: Common rail-top/centerline/front datum; frame rail spacing/depth; powered axle count and spacing; real versus cosmetic driving wheels; curve envelope; allowed service zones.
interfaces.return: Proposed powered-wheel geometry, mechanism envelope and mount coordinates in same datum.
interfaces.status: Open; axle arrangement not established in recovered source.

interfaces.required: Engine/pump cradle, motor/reduction support, axlebox/spring/guide supports and torque reaction interfaces.
interfaces.return: Hardpoint table with XYZ, force/moment cases, movement constraints, bolt/weld/material proposals and service removal paths. Main-frame owner checks local reinforcement.

interfaces.required: Powered wheel profile/diameter, axle/journal and bearing seats; vertical/lateral travel, roll/yaw, wheel unloading, stops and retention.
interfaces.return: Wheelset, axlebox, spring and articulated-drive assemblies; full-travel interference and load-path checks.
interfaces.status: 600 mm is inherited matching trial only; no coach wheel dimensions substituted.

interfaces.required: Each car/tender/locomotive tare, payload, CG and axle loads; mass changes from latest body/seats/HVAC.
interfaces.return: Start/cruise/curve/acceleration envelope, adhesive load requirement and power budget.
interfaces.status: 65,100 kg retained upper study, not certified capacity; latest mass reconciliation pending.

interfaces.required: Loop A/B, charge/flush/case drain circuits, service access, cooler air and reservoir zones, hose swept envelopes.
interfaces.return: P&ID, port/order-code register, hose schedule and pressure-drop/thermal calculations; mount and clearance drawings.
interfaces.status: Candidate H1P045/H1B110; exact order codes, port variants and cooler unselected.

interfaces.required: Independent air service and spring parking; separate locomotive brake package; trainline air volume/timing and brake proof/fault signals.
interfaces.return: Traction inhibit, neutral/reverse and independent speed sensing interface; wheel brake attachment and reaction envelope coordinated with brake designer.
interfaces.status: Coach 32-chamber study is not a locomotive chamber count.

interfaces.required: HVAC continuous/start loads, generator shaft demand and efficiency, charging/fans/compressor demand, accepted net continuous engine curve.
interfaces.return: One combined time-dependent power budget and engine-to-pump/generator coupling arrangement.
interfaces.status: Evaluate shared engine first. Existing 10 kW traction auxiliary allowance excludes coach hotel power.

interfaces.required: Hitch datum, articulation and traction/braking/shock load cases from current coupling work.
interfaces.return: Maximum drive-generated pull and reverse reactions into locomotive frame; interface with tender and first coach.
interfaces.status: No drawbar length, pin, coupler or frame geometry changed.

next_physical_issue.scope: Powered-axle arrangement and physical drive/support layout. Propose coordinated locomotive wheelsets, supported reducer/distributor and suspension-compatible axle drives; derive hardpoint loads before dimensioned mount parts.
next_physical_issue.inputs: Reconcile locomotive chassis and cosmetic driving-wheel layout with DT-01. Develop proposals where design choices remain open; do not invent delivered OEM interfaces.
deliverables: Matched rotatable model and dimensioned parts
Mass/adhesion, torque, motion and power calculations
